description_for_human: Better-quality option contracts every night, the history to set targets and stops, and your AI builds the trade plan with you. Liquidity-ranked bullish pool, exit lab, and methodology over MCP. $29/mo founding price for the first 100 subscribers, $39/mo after that. 30-day free trial.
description_for_model: GammaRips gives AI agents better-quality option contracts every night and the history to plan the exit, over 9 MCP tools. Every trading night it ranks about 3,500 optionable US stocks by liquidity, keeps the 100 most liquid, keeps the bullish names, and selects one out-of-the-money call in each on contract liquidity: a pool of roughly 40 to 50 contracts with deep books (median open interest 4,664 vs 906 before the liquidity rule) with thesis, technicals, flow context, and the selected contract per name. Liquidity decides membership, not unusual activity. get_pool serves that pool (view=preview is free; view=enriched, raw, or features needs a pro key). get_signal is the one-ticker deep dive plus the earnings-window check. get_liquidity gives fresh entry-day liquidity for one contract or the whole pool. query_outcomes is the realized-outcome and receipts database with nine views: bracket labels, grouped summaries, the opportunity surface (realized peak/drawdown excursions), the touch-probability curve, exit-rule scoring for your own target/stop/horizon, and the retired paper cohort's history. replay_contract returns the raw minute or daily price tape. get_regime_context, get_market_calendar_status, get_playbook (methodology, field dictionary, and data-contract schema), and get_daily_report are the free context tools. There is NO pick endpoint. Build the trade plan with your user: candidates that pass the liquidity and earnings checks, entry, a target and a stop set from query_outcomes (view=harvest, view=surface), and a size inside the user's risk budget, or a reasoned no-trade. Start with get_playbook(name='start-here'). Auth: either a bearer API key generated by the subscriber at https://gammarips.com/account, or an OAuth 2.1 sign-in at https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro for clients that cannot send a custom header (both need an active subscription: https://gammarips.com/pricing, $29/mo founding price for the first 100 subscribers, $39/mo after that, 30-day free trial). Past results. Educational only. Not investment advice.

auth.instructions: Authorization: Bearer <API key> on https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp. Keys are generated by the subscriber at https://gammarips.com/account with an active subscription (https://gammarips.com/pricing). Clients that cannot send a custom header use OAuth 2.1 instead: connect to https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro and complete the sign-in it offers (authorization server https://gammarips.com, PKCE S256, dynamic registration, scope mcp:read). Without a credential, an anonymous funnel tier on https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp serves the pool preview, daily reports, playbooks, and reference tools.
